subject: Humanities
objective_verbatim: Talk about what is fair and unfair.
unit_verbatim: Caring & fairness, stories that teach us

BUILD - Spring.D11: Caring & fairness, stories that teach us
BUILD - Spring.E11: Recognise right/kind actions in stories; talk about fairness; identify ways to care for others.

scaffold_level.label: Level 2 scaffolds
scaffold_level.meaning: word bank, sentence starter and visible model on every task and route

minimum_finish: Own four-card fair/unfair sort and one linked one-sentence reason for at least one card in each group, with actual reading mode and support recorded.

original_scenarios.text: Two pupils want one pen. They take turns. Both can draw.
original_scenarios.reason: It is fair because both have a turn.

original_scenarios.text: One pupil keeps all the paper. The other has none. They cannot join.
original_scenarios.reason: It is unfair because one has no paper.

original_scenarios.text: One pupil needs a thick grip. An adult gives them one. Both can draw.
original_scenarios.reason: It is fair because the grip helps one pupil join.

original_scenarios.text: Two pupils share a poster. One says, Only my ideas count. The other has no say.
original_scenarios.reason: It is unfair because one has no say.

evidence.description: Own fair/unfair sort, reason for one card in each group, actual reading mode and support

feedback_gate: Voice and audience reply present; one NS and pupil own response before R; actual banking before E.
careers_line: Share tools, hear ideas and help each person join.
communication_portfolio: Offer authentic reasons to the Communication portfolio.

slides.title: Fair and unfair choices
slides.text:
Talk about choices in four made-up cards.
Show fair or unfair.
Say why in one sentence.
You can point or ask an adult to write.

slides.title: Ready to start
slides.text:
Choose: ready, rest or help.
You can point in a quiet way.
Start: I feel __.
Model: I feel ready.
You can pause with an adult.

slides.title: A fair plan
slides.text:
Two pupils want to draw.
A Both get a sheet of paper.
B One keeps all the paper.
Choose the fair plan. You can point.
Words: fair, share, both. Start: I choose __ because __.
Model: I choose A because both can draw.

slides.title: Our choices task
slides.text:
Talk about what is fair and unfair.
Sort A–D. Give a reason for each group.
In your book: one fair and one unfair reason.
Words: fair, unfair, turn, share, help, say.
Start: It is fair because __. It is unfair because __.
Model: It is fair because both have a turn.

slides.title: Four made-up cards
slides.text:
A Both take turns. B One has no paper.
C A grip helps. D One has no say.
Words: fair, unfair, turn, help.
Start: It is fair because __.
Model: It is fair because both have a turn.

slides.title: Sort fair and unfair
slides.text:
Read or listen to each card.
Put A–D with fair or unfair.
Keep the picture board in view.
Show a card that fits each group.
Words: fair, unfair, turn, share, help, say.
Start: It is fair because __. It is unfair because __.
Model: It is fair because both have a turn.

slides.title: Different help
slides.text:
C An adult gives one pupil a thick grip.
Both can draw.
Is this fair or unfair? Say why in a quiet way.
Words: fair, unfair, turn, share, help, say.
Start: It is fair because __. It is unfair because __.
Model: It is fair because both have a turn.

slides.title: My book reasons
slides.text:
Supported: choose words. An adult can write.
Independent: sort A–D and give two reasons.
Aspire: give two reasons, then a fair change to B or D.
In your book: one fair and one unfair reason.
Words: fair, unfair, turn, share, help, say.
Start: It is fair because __. It is unfair because __.
Model: It is fair because both have a turn.

slides.title: My quiet check
slides.text:
Check your two card choices and reasons.
Read or listen to each sentence.
Keep or change it after one next step.
Words: fair, unfair, turn, share, help, say.
Start: It is fair because __. It is unfair because __.
Model: It is fair because both have a turn.

slides.title: My last step
slides.text:
Show one fair card and one unfair card.
Tell or point to why.
Show an adult in a quiet way.
Words: fair, unfair, turn, share, help, say.
Start: It is fair because __. It is unfair because __.
Model: It is fair because both have a turn.

slides.title: Fair and unfair words
slides.text:
fair: each can join and get the help they need.
unfair: one is kept out or has no fair chance.
turn: a time when you use a shared thing.
share: let each person have or use some.
help: make it easier for someone to join.
say: a chance to give your idea.
Start: It is unfair because __.
Model: It is unfair because one has no paper.

slides.title: Adult support brief
slides.text:
Three to four pupils. Use Pupil number: ____ for each pupil.
10, 15 and 15 minute blocks; brief resets within.
Keep word bank, starter and model on EVERY task.
No public questions, cold calling or required reading aloud.
Exact scribe: pupil choice, private read-back, keep/change.
R: Voice + audience reply + one NS + own response.
E: actual banking. Record reading mode and actual help.
